meta.title: Todo Inbox
meta.description: When the user-attention plugin auto-rejects an approval or question because the user is away or offline, the decision is kept here instead of being lost. Review it in the right Sidebar or the composer highlight bar: approve once so the model runs the original tool through todo_execute (arguments are hash-verified against the source session log and a one-shot grant bypasses the attention gate), or answer the stored questions. Rejected todos can be sent back for changes and are only archived when applying an operation or when the AI calls a todo tool; executed items are deleted.
